messages.author: 294ca849ade06069
messages.subject: unroot tree tiplab () can't adjust the direction of the label？
parts:
Hello Teacher Yu, I have a question about the rootless tree tiplab I would like to ask you. When I draw the daylight unroot tree, there is no way to adjust the position of the tiplab. I want the result below.

















But I got the following result, tiplabels are not arranged in the direction of the tree.













Because the data has not been published yet, I will send the tree file to your google mailbox, hoping to get guidance from teacher Yu.

code：

tree <- read.newick("sl_at_tree.nwk")

p <- ggtree(tree, layout = "daylight")
p1 <- p + geom_tiplab()
print(p1
      )

messages.subject: Re: unroot tree tiplab () can't adjust the direction of the label？
parts: there is no such issue in the latest release version of ggtree, see https://github.com/YuLab-SMU/ggtree/issues/292.
